name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v3452: v3447 taught the gate-set step to publish red, wired it through the job outputs and into the verdict step env, and then branched only on reached. So a GREEN gate set plus any later step failure announced GATES RED. The gate-set comment names that exact path and the code below it did not implement it. Also: run_gates exit 2 means the tree was locked and NO gate ran, and folding it into red=true published a verdict nobody reached. Found by the cross-family eye on the shipped v3451 bytes.
